summary.text: PAUDBUNL is a batch IMS DL/I unload utility (entry DLITCBL with PCB mask PAUTBPCB; run by UNLDPADB.JCL as DLI with PSB PAUTBUNL) that copies the pending authorization database to two sequential files. It reads every PAUTSUM0 summary root with unqualified GN calls; for each summary with a numeric account id it writes the 100-byte summary to OUTFIL1 and then reads each PAUTDTL1 child with GNP and writes a record of the packed account id (ROOT-SEG-KEY) plus the 200-byte detail to OUTFIL2. It ends at end of database ('GB'); unexpected IMS statuses or open failures end with RETURN-CODE 16.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.logic: Entered via ENTRY 'DLITCBL' using PAUTBPCB; performs 1000-INITIALIZE, repeats 2000-FIND-NEXT-AUTH-SUMMARY until WS-END-OF-ROOT-SEG = 'Y', closes the files and GOBACKs.

paragraphs.name: 1000-INITIALIZE
paragraphs.logic: Accepts and displays the current date, then opens OPFILE1 and OPFILE2 for output; a status other than spaces/'00' displays the error and performs 9999-ABEND.

paragraphs.name: 2000-FIND-NEXT-AUTH-SUMMARY
paragraphs.logic: Calls CBLTDLI GN with ROOT-UNQUAL-SSA on PAUTBPCB. On blank status counts the read, moves the summary to OPFIL1-REC and PA-ACCT-ID to ROOT-SEG-KEY and, if PA-ACCT-ID is numeric, writes OPFIL1-REC and loops 3000-FIND-NEXT-AUTH-DTL until end of children. 'GB' ends the root loop; any other status displays 'AUTH SUM  GN FAILED' and performs 9999-ABEND.

paragraphs.name: 3000-FIND-NEXT-AUTH-DTL
paragraphs.logic: Calls CBLTDLI GNP with CHILD-UNQUAL-SSA. On blank status moves the detail to CHILD-SEG-REC and writes OPFIL2-REC (account key + detail); 'GE' sets WS-END-OF-CHILD-SEG = 'Y'; other statuses display 'GNP CALL FAILED' and perform 9999-ABEND. Clears PAUT-PCB-STATUS.

paragraphs.name: 4000-FILE-CLOSE
paragraphs.logic: Closes OPFILE1 and OPFILE2, displaying an error message for a non-'00' status (no abend).

paragraphs.name: 9999-ABEND
paragraphs.logic: Displays 'IMSUNLOD ABENDING ...', sets RETURN-CODE 16 and GOBACKs.

paragraphs.name: 9999-EXIT
paragraphs.logic: Exit point of 9999-ABEND (EXIT only, not reached).

rules.statement: Only pending authorization summaries with a numeric account id are unloaded; for each such summary the summary record is written to OUTFIL1 and each child detail is written to OUTFIL2 prefixed with the packed account id so it can be re-parented on reload.
rules.outcome: WRITE OPFIL1-REC; WRITE OPFIL2-REC per detail with ROOT-SEG-KEY = PA-ACCT-ID.

rules.statement: The unload stops with return code 16 when an output file cannot be opened or when IMS returns an unexpected status (not blank/'GB' on summary, not blank/'GE' on detail).
rules.anchor: IF PAUT-PCB-STATUS NOT EQUAL TO  SPACES AND 'GB'
rules.conditions: Open status not spaces/'00'; unexpected PCB status

observations.text: WRITE OPFIL1-REC and WRITE OPFIL2-REC are not followed by a file-status check.
Detail reads increment WS-NO-SUMRY-READ and WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT instead of a detail counter; no counts are displayed.
Program displays 'IMSUNLOD' as its name (WS-PGMNAME and abend text) instead of PAUDBUNL.
PRM-INFO, checkpoint id, expiry/day-diff fields and IMS-RETURN-CODE 88-levels are unused copies from CBPAUP0C.
